steps.text: NA-0755 v2 — the SINGLE-VIEW mint. Fresh profile: onboard first, because invite_create needs an unlocked vault and an identity.
Z1 baseline: the stub note starts hidden. This is what the un-stub seal is measured against.
ENTRY 1 — the welcome button. It opens STRAIGHT to the mint: there is no explainer step in v2.

Z1 NEGATIVE PIN, HANDLER-scoped (R380 §4): btn-add-contact no longer reveals #stub-note. The element and its TWO Lane-C revealers survive — the global 'the stub message is GONE' claim measured FALSE and was struck.
The mint IS the landing. Copy pinned as RENDERED; the mockup-verbatim SOURCE bytes are pinned in design_polish.rs.

steps.literal: Who is this invite for? (optional — stays on this device)

steps.text: R382 §3 — with no relay configured the SINGLE COMMIT is DISABLED, not left to fail. An enabled button whose only outcome is an error is the control-that-cannot-succeed shape.

steps.literal: Set a relay address in Settings → Relay before creating an invite.

steps.text: The slot counter is visible in BOTH states, so the cap can never ambush.
The list view is one click away, and it is empty on a fresh profile.
Escape closes, and the code box is cleared — the one-time boundary's local half.
ENTRY 2 — the '+' in the Chats header opens the SAME surface, so the flow survives the welcome pane disappearing.

⚠ NOT DRIVEN HERE: a successful mint, the clipboard write, Cancel, and the per-row Remove. No fixture relay exists (ENG-0226), so the green path is the operator's card. The clipboard mechanism is sealed in design_polish.rs, and readText is DENIED to the harness so no automated check could verify clipboard CONTENT anyway.
